title: ModelRisk — the response queue for an ERM (v1)
description: GET /api/erm/v1/model-risk/attention. Every outstanding obligation, individually. The console collapses these into rows (twenty overdue remediation steps become one row per owner); that is a presentation decision and stays in the console. Each item carries 'group' so a consumer can reproduce the same rollup, or list every record instead.

as_of.description: The date the registers were read against. Dated rules (review currency, remediation dates) move with it.

generated_at.description: When this response was produced, UTC. Present so a stale panel can say it is stale.

institution.description: The institution's own name for itself.

truncated.description: Declared, never silent: a capped list that says nothing about the cap reads as the whole of it.

group.description: The reason this item collapses under in the console, or null if it does not collapse.

kind.description: What sort of thing this is about.

tier.description: The institution's own criticality tier, or null.

due.description: The date somebody set, or null. Never inferred.

action.description: The instruction that closes it, in the same words the signed audit report uses.

href.description: A link to the record in the console, or null where the console has no screen for it — a dead link in somebody else's dashboard is worse than none.
